And here are four things you actually need to know about the Meta Ads MCP connector 1. You don't need to be a developer to install it. There's no API setup or coding required. But it will pull your real campaign performance insights, catalog data. So AI can actually analyze what's working and, you know, give you ideas. But I would take them with a grain of salt. But you can now also edit campaigns with a natural language instead of clicking through all of the freaking menus and Ads Manager. And you can tell AI to actually just update your ads set, create a new campaign, whatever you want to do. Lastly, it works across 4 channels. You can use your AI to pull insights from meta and compare them with your other platforms all in one place. If you want a link to get this installed inside of your AI, drop the word meta and I'll send you the link to the MCP so you can go install it with your Claude or your ChatGPT.
